svg.title: 7. Testing infrastructure class diagram
svg.desc: UML preview. Open the companion draw.io file to edit classes and connections.

text.tspan: Concrete shared helpers, nested test doubles and their production / framework contracts. Nested names include the containing class.

Tests use real SQLite schema / transactions through SqliteTestDatabase, fake provider client / session interfaces for offline Copilot tests, HtmlRenderer for rendered HTML, bUnit for UI events, WebApplicationFactory for host integration, and Playwright for the browser journey.
Multiple qualified names in one box represent distinct small local helpers with the same contract; no shared helper class is implied.
